items.headline: Global Crude Oil Prices Surge Past $100 Per Barrel as Middle East Conflicts Escalate
items.summary: Global benchmark Brent crude oil surged past $100 per barrel following intensified military strikes on energy infrastructure and shipping routes in the Middle East. The sudden price jump has heightened international inflation concerns and triggered notable losses across global stock markets.

items.headline: Apple Unveils First Foldable Smartphone and AI Upgrades at Annual Showcase
items.summary: On September 9, Apple announced its first foldable device, the iPhone Duo, alongside the new iPhone 18 lineup and enhanced Siri AI features. The launch event marked the first major hardware showcase presented by chief executive John Ternus following his transition into the role.

items.headline: Ben Shelton Upsets Carlos Alcaraz in Record Late-Night US Open Quarterfinal
items.summary: American Ben Shelton dethroned defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set quarterfinal match at the US Open. The epic marathon concluded at 3:33 a.m., marking the latest match finish in tournament history and sending Shelton into the semifinals.

items.headline: Nirvana Named Recipient of the Video Vanguard Award for the 2026 MTV VMAs
items.summary: MTV announced that iconic rock band Nirvana will receive the prestigious Video Vanguard Award at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards on September 27 in Los Angeles. The honor comes 35 years after the filming of their groundbreaking 'Smells Like Teen Spirit' music video, celebrating the group's lasting impact on music culture.
